BlzFilter::Transform.sig: HRESULT(void* this, IMediaSample* in, IMediaSample* out)
BlzFilter::Transform.doc: The BLZ0 (DivX) filter's CTransformFilter::Transform: decodes one frame into the output sample, but never sets its length, so the sample keeps its whole buffer's (width * 4 * height). These bytes run up to the output sample's GetMediaType (this in ebp). movie-frame-length wraps it through its vtable slot under Wine. See docs/reverse-engineering.md, blizzard.ax.

BlzFilter.vtable.Transform_slot.doc: The filter's vtable slot (.data1) holding BlzFilter::Transform; movie-frame-length points it at its wrapper (patch_pointer).

BlzFilter.width.doc: int32: the movie's width. Set by SetMediaType (0x34D0) and by Transform when a sample changes the type, as are the fields below.

BlzFilter.format.doc: uint32: the output format code (core/movie_decoder.h, Format: 1 YUY2, 2 UYVY, 4 RGB32, 6 RGB24, 8 RGB555, 0xA RGB565, 0xD YV12/I420).

BlzFilter.output_width.doc: int32: the output type's biWidth, the row width Transform writes (0x404498); 0 means the movie's width rounded up to 32.
